facts.business: EFC (I) Limited is a Real Estate-as-a-Service provider that reimagines the managed workplace landscape through an integrated platform combining workspace solutions, design and build expertise, and furniture manufacturing.
facts.related_party_note: Trade receivables considered good from related parties were Rs 8,330.37 lakhs as at March 31, 2026 (Rs 1,630.48 lakhs as at March 31, 2025).
